title: NucleoMag Blood for DNA Purification from Blood
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Add Proteinase K buffer
steps.instruction: Dispense 50 µL Proteinase K buffer into each well of the 96‑well plate and mix the well immediately after addition.

steps.title: Add bead buffer
steps.instruction: Dispense 162.5 µL bead buffer into each well, mixing each well as the buffer is added. Ensure the bead buffer is thoroughly mixed in its reservoir before dispensing to prevent bead settling.

steps.title: Incubate on magnet (first)
steps.instruction: Place the plate on the magnetic module and engage for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Remove supernatant (first)
steps.instruction: Aspirate the supernatant from all wells without disturbing the magnetic beads. If the volume cannot be removed in one aspiration, repeat the aspiration until the supernatant is fully removed.

steps.title: Incubate on magnet (second)
steps.instruction: Place the plate back on the magnetic module and engage for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Remove supernatant (second)
steps.instruction: Aspirate any remaining supernatant from all wells without disturbing the beads; repeat the aspiration if necessary.

steps.title: Add MBL3 buffer
steps.instruction: Remove the plate from the magnet and dispense 400 µL MBL3 buffer into each well, mixing each well as the buffer is added. If the full volume cannot be delivered in one dispense, repeat the dispense‑mix cycle until 400 µL is reached.

substeps.instruction: Dispense 400 µL MBL3 buffer and mix.
If needed, repeat to reach total volume.

steps.title: Incubate on magnet (third)
steps.instruction: Place the plate on the magnetic module and engage for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Remove supernatant (third)
steps.instruction: Aspirate the MBL3 supernatant from all wells without disturbing the beads; repeat the aspiration if required to remove all liquid.

steps.title: Add ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Remove the plate from the magnet and add 400 µL of 80 % ethanol to each well, mixing each well as the ethanol is added.

steps.title: Incubate on magnet (fourth)
steps.instruction: Place the plate back on the magnetic module and engage for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Remove ethanol supernatant
steps.instruction: Aspirate the ethanol from all wells without disturbing the beads; repeat the aspiration if necessary to remove all ethanol.

steps.title: Air‑dry beads
steps.instruction: Leave the plate on the magnetic module (with magnets engaged) and allow the beads to air‑dry for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Add MBL5 buffer
steps.instruction: Remove the plate from the magnet and dispense either 100 µL or 50 µL MBL5 buffer into each well (as specified), mixing each well as the buffer is added.

steps.title: Incubate on magnet (final)
steps.instruction: Place the plate on the magnetic module and engage for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Transfer eluate to storage plate
steps.instruction: Transfer the eluate (either 50 µL or 100 µL per well, matching the volume added in the previous step) from each well to the final DNA storage plate, taking care not to disturb the magnetic beads.
